title: 천이백 원
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Hip-Hop with R&B influences. A male rapper delivers rhythmic, syncopated verses followed by a melodic, soulful chorus. The production features a prominent, funky electric bassline playing syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. A clean, jazzy electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs and occasional melodic fills. The drum kit consists of a tight, dry snare and a punchy kick drum. A subtle, shimmering synth pad provides harmonic depth in the background. The track is in the key of G Major at 95 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal delivery transitions from a percussive rap flow to a smooth, layered vocal harmony in the chorus.
